supersedes.failure: ModalResult exposes status; the original harness read nonexistent numerical_status.

changes: Read ModalResult.status as the numerical route status.
For a PASS result, require exactly four finite frequency values and a finite full mode matrix with shape (30, 4).

hypothesis: The QF TET10 modal route can compute and report the first four modes of a one-element, one-face-fixed model; a dense eigenproblem on the same QF-assembled reduced K/M provides a numerical cross-check without validating TET10 spatial accuracy.

model.geometry: unit right tetrahedron with standard ten-node midside placement
model.element: one quadratic TET10 with default linear-elastic stiffness and consistent mass
model.boundary_conditions: UX, UY, UZ fixed at the six TET10 nodes on x=0; 12 free DOFs and 30 total DOFs
model.initial_or_forcing_conditions: not applicable to undamped free vibration
model.inputs: Model geometry, connectivity, material, and supports are defined explicitly in the source file bound above; there are no external model files.

reference.method: scipy.linalg.eigh generalized symmetric eigenproblem on the same QF-assembled Kff and Mff
reference.scope: same-operator numerical comparison for this route smoke

observables: frequency count and finite positive values
mode matrix shape and finite values
relative frequency differences to the dense same-operator solution
Kff, Mff, reference modes, returned frequencies and modes in the state archive

status_rules.PASS: QF status must remain PASS and include exactly four finite positive frequencies and four finite mode vectors arranged as a full matrix of shape (30, 4); report the dense same-operator comparison.
status_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: Preserve INCONCLUSIVE, the exact QF validation payload and any usable outputs; do not relabel as PASS.
status_rules.FAIL: Preserve FAIL and serialize available diagnostics without relabeling it as numerical PASS.
status_rules.no_numeric_acceptance_threshold: Frequency differences are descriptive; no formal frequency accuracy threshold or qualification claim is made.

execution.budget_semantics: Timeout and output caps are launcher controlled; RSS, process count, temporary/archive size, and free disk are sampled/soft observations, not OS quotas.
execution.preflight: A fresh exact-node collect-only receipt on this committed source is required before the single corrective attempt.
execution.external_solver: Not used; SciPy compares the same QF-assembled operators.

preservation.j10_modal_attempt_001: PYTEST_FAILED retained unchanged; no results inferred from its solver return.
